d:
PROVE THEM WRONG is a war cry from the trenches, for anyone who’s ever been laughed at for dreaming too loud, doubted for believing too much, or mocked for trying too hard. Sometimes, the loudest revenge is success.
Credits:
Singer - Parmish Verma
Lyrics & Composition - Laddi Chahal
Music - Starboy X
Mix & Master - Dense
Video - Director Chief
Thank you - BOX TO FIT - Gym Big love, Amit bro, thank you for opening your gym and your heart for my video.
